Package arcade.patch.env.component

Class PatchComponentPulse

java.lang.Object
arcade.patch.env.component.PatchComponentPulse
All Implemented Interfaces:
Component, Serializable, sim.engine.Steppable
public class PatchComponentPulse extends Object implements Component
Implementation of Component for pulsing sources.

This component can only be used with PatchComponentSitesSource. Multiple pulsed molecules are tracked by a list of PatchComponentPulse.PulseLayer objects.

The amount of media (MEDIA_AMOUNT) is used to determine the total amount of molecule available given total simulation area. The molecule concentration is updated each step as the molecule is consumed or otherwise removed from the environment. At the specified pulse interval (PULSE_INTERVAL), a "pulse" of media is introduced, updating the total amount of molecule available.
